description.p: Prchum reviews code: pull requests from GitHub, Forgejo and GitLab, git comparisons, and plain patch files. Comments anchor to a semantic location rather than to a position in a diff, so a draft survives the branch moving under it, and nothing you have written is lost when the request is updated.
It never asks for a token. Forges are reached through the command line tools you have already authenticated — gh, glab or fj — so credentials stay where you put them.

ul.li: Drafts that persist, with relocation when the code moves
Threads already on the request, answered in place
Syntax colouring, split view, and the whole file behind a hunk
A queue of what is waiting for you
Submission that can be retried without posting anything twice
